semantics.clock: All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
semantics.reset: Synchronous active-high reset has priority over in and selects A on a rising edge. Assertion between rising edges does not change state or output.
semantics.initialization: No power-up state is specified; defined operation begins after a rising edge with reset high.
semantics.output_timing: out decodes the current registered state, including the new state after a rising edge; changes to in alone do not change out.

numeric.signals: All public signals are single-bit unsigned logic.
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, rounding, saturation, or overflow behavior is present.
numeric.state_encoding: Internal encoding is an implementation choice; four states require two bits.

verification.oracle: Independent integer-state model implementing the original transition table and Moore output map.
verification.coverage: Exhaust all 256 eight-bit input sequences from reset, track all eight state/input transitions, and test reset from every state with both input values.
verification.timing: Compare after each rising edge settles; change input and assert reset between rising edges and check output is unchanged until the next edge.
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12, -g2012, explicit dev_tb top, finite compile and simulation timeouts, self-checking PASS/FAIL and internal watchdog.

specification_ambiguities: Power-up state before synchronous reset is unspecified; no pre-reset output is required.
